name: Photoresistor (LDR, GL5528)
description: Light-dependent resistor, GL5528 class: about 15 kΩ at 10 lux, under 1 kΩ in bright light, 1 MΩ in the dark. Use it as the top or bottom of a divider with a 10 kΩ resistor into an analog pin.

props.label: Illuminance
props.description: Light falling on the sensor. 1 lx moonlit room, 100 lx living room, 500 lx office, 10 000+ lx daylight.

footprint: THT 5 mm LDR, 0.1 in lead pitch

bindings.description: Light level 0..1 on a log scale (0 = dark, 1 = 100 000 lx), for the glow overlay.
